name: Inari Amertron Berhad
overview: 今年公司终止了与 Sanan Optoelectronics 联合收购 Lumileds International 100% 股权的计划，该交易不再推进。其余公告主要为股息、股东大会及治理相关事项，未披露各业务板块的产能扩张、新合约或业务缩减。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增13.1%，净利润同比增18.5%。
overview_en: During the year, the company terminated the proposed joint acquisition of 100% equity interest in Lumileds International with Sanan Optoelectronics, and the transaction will not proceed. The remaining announcements mainly relate to dividends, general meetings and governance matters, with no disclosed capacity expansion, new contracts or business downsizing for any business segment. In the latest quarter (2026-09-30), revenue rose 13.1% YoY and net profit rose 18.5% YoY.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面终止了联合收购 Lumileds International 的计划，未披露其他业务板块的具体动态。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the proposed joint acquisition of Lumileds International was terminated this year; no other specific segment developments were disclosed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司、Sanan Optoelectronics 与 Lumileds Subholding B.V. 于2026年4月30日签订两份终止协议，正式结束上述联合收购。
actions.text_en: The company, Sanan Optoelectronics and Lumileds Subholding B.V. entered into two termination agreements on 30 April 2026 to formally conclude the proposed joint acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司、Sanan Optoelectronics 与 Lumileds Subholding B.V. 于2026年4月17日同意终止联合收购 Lumileds International 100% 股权的计划。
actions.text_en: The company, Sanan Optoelectronics and Lumileds Subholding B.V. agreed on 17 April 2026 to terminate the proposed joint acquisition of 100% equity interest in Lumileds International.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS

model_changes.text_en: The company terminated the proposed joint acquisition of 100% equity interest in Lumileds International, and did not add this entire business line.
